title: Refactor Slow Query Logger
problem_statement: The slow query logger uses hardcoded paths and lacks error handling.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues.
suggested_approach: Refactor to use environment variables for paths and implement error handling.
success_criteria: Paths are configurable via environment variables.

provenance.evidence: Hardcoded file path and lack of error handling.
